title: Outlook: custom descriptions on follow-up flags in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web

summary: The roadmap facts, Outlook licensing background and absence of a documented feature-specific admin switch are supported. The risk rationale should not promise that descriptions move no data or act on nothing: Microsoft has not documented those behaviours. All four Learn pages flagged by the pre-check opened successfully.
